title: OCS '23
shortDescription: Organising Committee Selections portal for ACM-VIT, 2023. A terminal-themed website - the whole recruitment flow dressed up as a command line interface.
longDescription: OCS '23 was ACM-VIT's recruitment portal for the 2023 organising committee. The whole site was built around a terminal aesthetic - typed prompts, monospace UI, command-line flow.
It's the second in the chapter's run of themed OCS sites, following the 2022 RPG portal.

features.title: Terminal UI
features.description: Whole site styled as a command-line interface.
